principles: Digital nodes mirror verified legal arrangements; they do not establish trusts or companies
Owner approves appointments, contracts, spending, payouts and publication
One canonical commerce ledger and product catalog

entity_types.purpose: Record governing documents, beneficiaries, decisions and verification status

Represent ownership interests only with supporting documents
Provide approved shared services and worker supervision

No recurring billing without explicit customer consent
No subscription offering until ongoing value and support are ready

accounting: Provider transaction IDs deduplicated across brand, store, affiliate and subscription views
